tutorial.title: Sections Using Named Areas
tutorial.descriptionContent: Use named areas to create a webpage with different sections.

lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent: We can use grid to lay out a simple game HUD like the one shown below. Let's learn how to use named areas to create these HUD sections.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
The first step to creating sections is giving grid items descriptive class names.

Give a class name to the element that contains the game view.

Make sure to pick viewport.

lessons.title: Lesson #3
lessons.interactiveContent:
To name grid items, we code the grid-area property inside each item CSS rule and assign the appropriate area names.

Set grid-area name to viewport.

Make sure to pick grid-area, followed by viewport.

lessons.title: Lesson #4
lessons.interactiveContent:
Let's take another look at the HUD layout we want to create. How do you think we could implement this design?

By splitting the HUD into two columnsWe can do this with one column only

By splitting the HUD into two columns.

lessons.title: Lesson #5
lessons.interactiveContent:
Now that we have named areas, we can create sections just by splitting up content into columns and rows.

Set grid-template-areas to "inventory viewport".

Make sure to pick grid-template-areas followed by " and then inventory, viewport, ".

lessons.title: Lesson #6
lessons.interactiveContent:
Although the middle part is split into columns, the status bar and event log span across the entire width of the HUD. How do we get that?

By spanning those named areas across all the columnsBy spanning those named areas across all the rows

By spanning those named areas across all the columns.

lessons.title: Lesson #7
lessons.interactiveContent:
To make the status bar span across the width of the entire HUD, we just set grid-template-areas to "status status".

Make sure to pick " followed by status and then status, ".

lessons.title: Lesson #8
lessons.interactiveContent:
If we want to create an event log section, we add the log grid name twice to take up the entire last row.

Make sure to pick " followed by log and then log, ".

lessons.title: Lesson #9
lessons.interactiveContent:
We've covered a very basic game HUD layout, but CSS Grid can be used to build far more powerful interfaces depending on our game.

Make sure to pick "inventory minimap minimap action".

lessons.title: Lesson #10
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when we use the property in the following code?

We give the name status to the grid itemWe give the class name status to the grid item

We give the name status to the grid item.

lessons.title: Lesson #11
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does this code display?

A status bar spanning three columnsA status bar spanning three rows

A status bar spanning three columns.

lessons.title: Lesson #12
lessons.interactiveContent:
How will the "inventory" value display as a section in the following code?

As one column in the second rowAs two columns in the second row

As one column in the second row.

lessons.title: Lesson #13
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which grid-template-areas value creates the middle row of this HUD grid?

"inventory inventory viewport""inventory viewport viewport"

"inventory inventory viewport".

lessons.title: Lesson #14
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which grid-template-areas value creates the log section below?

"log log""log log log"

"log log".

lessons.title: Lesson #15
lessons.interactiveContent:
Add the status and inventory classes to the correct elements.

Make sure to pick status, followed by inventory.

lessons.title: Lesson #16
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the grid-template-areas value to span the status bar across three columns.

Make sure to pick status, followed by status, and finally status.

lessons.title: Lesson #17
lessons.interactiveContent:
Add an inventory section to the right of the game view.

Make sure to type inventory.

lessons.title: Lesson #18
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the inventory area span over two rows.

Make sure to pick inventory, followed by inventory.

lessons.title: Lesson #19
lessons.interactiveContent:
Add the correct code such that the event log section spans the entire grid row.

Make sure to type log log.
